commands.title: Open Doc
commands.description: Show a Markdown (.md, .markdown) or mermaid (.mmd) file rendered, with diagrams drawn, in a popup over the user's workspace; it takes focus and updates while the file changes. Call it after you write a spec, plan or report the user should read. Only files inside the workspace's folders, their git worktrees and agent uploads open; fails with not in workspace, not a document, too large (over 4 MiB) or not found.

path.description: File to show; absolute, or relative to the session's worktree (else the workspace's first folder).

session.description: Agent session whose worktree a relative path is resolved against; default the calling session.

commands.title: Read Doc
commands.description: Render a Markdown or mermaid file of the workspace to an HTML fragment; the path stays watched and docs.changed is published when it changes.

path.description: File to read; absolute, or relative to the workspace's first folder.

title.description: First # heading, else the file name.

html.description: HTML fragment for the document template.

rev.description: Revision of the file, grows on every change.
